snapshot.scope: Source-level, finite user-visible functional workflows and their direct handoffs/dependencies; not an enumeration of every execution path, internal function or deployed service.
snapshot.verification: source-enumeration; no new database, LAN, SSH, browser-to-Engine or kernel execution tests

name.zh-CN: 编辑器与本地 eBPF 链路

chain.en: launcher → config validation → AppState → routes → health
chain.zh-CN: 启动器 → 配置校验 → AppState → 路由 → 健康检查

boundary.en: Invalid mode/catalog/config fails startup; health is not proof of kernel readiness.
boundary.zh-CN: 模式、清单或配置非法会阻止启动；健康响应不证明内核可运行。

chain.en: helper → environment tools/kernel checks + user Runner status → report
chain.zh-CN: 帮助页 → 工具链/内核检查 + 用户 Runner 状态 → 报告

boundary.en: Read-only diagnostics; no automatic installation or privilege repair.
boundary.zh-CN: 只读诊断，不自动安装工具或修复权限。

chain.en: settings → resident/on-demand mode + check/completion metrics → bounded polling
chain.zh-CN: 设置页 → 常驻缓存/按需模式 + 检查/补全指标 → 有界轮询

boundary.en: Compiler setting is instance-wide runtime state; metrics are not full distributed tracing.
boundary.zh-CN: 编译模式是实例级运行时状态；指标不是全链路分布式追踪。

chain.en: register form → server policy/password validation → AuthService → TOTP enrollment
chain.zh-CN: 注册页 → 服务端策略/密码校验 → AuthService → TOTP 绑定信息

boundary.en: Policy-gated; cannot select teacher authority or obtain a login session from registration.
boundary.zh-CN: 受注册开关限制；不能自选教师身份，注册不自动登录。

chain.en: OTP setup → bootstrap policy → password verification → QR/secret
chain.zh-CN: OTP 设置页 → 初始化开关 → 密码验证 → 二维码/密钥

boundary.en: Opt-in bootstrap, not arbitrary credential reset; sensitive response must not enter this inventory.
boundary.zh-CN: 初始化需显式启用，不是任意凭据重置；本清单不收集敏感响应。

chain.en: password + TOTP → throttle/verification → session persistence → cookie → me/route guard
chain.zh-CN: 密码 + TOTP → 限流/验证 → 会话持久化 → Cookie → me/路由鉴权

boundary.en: Teacher role is server-owned, including solo default teacher; active-SQL login needs confirmed session insertion before cookie publication.
boundary.zh-CN: 教师身份由服务端决定，单人默认教师；活跃 SQL 登录必须确认会话写入后才发 Cookie。

chain.en: logout → Origin policy → revoke session → clear cookie → login page
chain.zh-CN: 退出 → Origin 检查 → 撤销会话 → 清 Cookie → 登录页

boundary.en: Unconfirmed storage mutation must not report success; logout does not detach kernel programs.
boundary.zh-CN: 存储变更未确认不得报成功；退出不会卸载内核程序。

chain.en: account confirmation → current password + OTP → conditional durable credential update → cache
chain.zh-CN: 账户确认 → 当前密码 + OTP → 条件式持久化凭据更新 → 缓存

boundary.en: Storage failure fails closed for the mutation; changing a password currently does not revoke existing sessions.
boundary.zh-CN: 存储失败拒绝确认变更；当前修改密码不会撤销既有会话。

chain.en: destructive confirmation → password + OTP → delete account and sessions → clear cookie
chain.zh-CN: 危险操作确认 → 密码 + OTP → 删除账户及会话 → 清 Cookie

boundary.en: Default teacher/last-account deletion is rejected. Deleting auth data is not a cross-service purge of scripts, attempts, events or kernel attachments.
boundary.zh-CN: 拒绝删除默认教师/最后账户。删除认证数据不是脚本、提交、事件或内核挂载的跨服务清理。

chain.en: teacher link → well-known document → origin/classroom/protocol/capability checks → confirmation
chain.zh-CN: 教师链接 → well-known 文档 → 来源/课堂/协议/能力校验 → 确认

boundary.en: Opt-in discovery; no LAN scan/mDNS. Non-loopback enrollment requires HTTPS at the browser boundary.
boundary.zh-CN: 发现需启用；没有局域网扫描/mDNS。浏览器端非回环接入要求 HTTPS。

chain.en: teaching page → named student invitation → one-time token → list/revoke
chain.zh-CN: 教学页 → 绑定学生名的邀请 → 一次性令牌 → 列表/撤销

boundary.en: Short-lived in-memory invitation digests; reserved teacher names rejected; revocation does not revoke existing accounts/sessions.
boundary.zh-CN: 短期邀请摘要存内存；拒绝教师保留名；撤销邀请不撤销已建立账户/会话。

chain.en: confirmed identity + invitation + username/password → redeem → account creation → save TOTP → normal login
chain.zh-CN: 确认身份 + 邀请 + 用户名/密码 → 核销 → 创建账户 → 保存 TOTP → 正常登录

boundary.en: Invitation is consumed before registration; conflict/failure does not restore it. No auto-login, role promotion, Agent enrollment or transactional rollback across both services.
boundary.zh-CN: 先核销再注册；冲突/失败不返还邀请。不自动登录、提权、注册 Agent，也没有两服务整体回滚。

chain.en: editor → list/save/delete → owner-bound ScriptStore → SQL or local JSON → explicit draft load
chain.zh-CN: 编辑器 → 列表/保存/删除 → 按所有者隔离的 ScriptStore → SQL 或本地 JSON → 显式载入草稿

boundary.en: Save is not execution. Local persistence completes before cache publication; corrupt snapshots are not overwritten.
boundary.zh-CN: 保存不是执行。本地持久化完成后才发布缓存；损坏快照不被覆盖。

chain.en: startup manifest discovery → module inventory → start/stop state
chain.zh-CN: 启动时发现 manifest → 模块清单 → start/stop 状态

boundary.en: Two bundled manifests; lifecycle only changes in-memory state, not process execution or eBPF authorization.
boundary.zh-CN: 内置两个 manifest；生命周期只改内存状态，不启动进程，也不作为 eBPF 执行授权开关。

chain.en: terminal parser → typed command → dispatcher → module action or editor navigation
chain.zh-CN: 终端解析 → 类型化命令 → 分发器 → 模块操作或跳转编辑器

boundary.en: Not a shell; run_experiment returns an editor path and does not run code.
boundary.zh-CN: 不是 Shell；run_experiment 只返回编辑器路径，不执行代码。

chain.en: catalog → verified download/select/delete → selected metadata → local check/completion/run injection
chain.zh-CN: 目录 → 校验下载/选择/删除 → 已选元数据 → 本地检查/补全/运行注入

boundary.en: Allowlisted artifact and digest verification precede publication; selection is shared within an instance, not automatically transferred to remote Agents.
boundary.zh-CN: 允许列表和摘要验证先于发布；选择为实例共享，不会自动传输到远程 Agent。

chain.en: 48-template catalog/local file/session draft → preview or selection → confirmed replacement → editor
chain.zh-CN: 48 个模板/本地文件/会话草稿 → 预览或选择 → 确认替换 → 编辑器

boundary.en: Changing lab/template/source never implicitly runs code; late imports and unconfirmed navigation are guarded.
boundary.zh-CN: 切换实验、模板或源码不会隐式执行；过期导入与未确认导航受保护。

chain.en: editor debounce/manual check → source validation → Runner check permit/driver → clang → diagnostics
chain.zh-CN: 编辑器防抖/手动检查 → 源码校验 → Runner 检查许可/驱动 → clang → 诊断

boundary.en: No kernel load; check capacity, timeout and unavailable backend are explicit. Local static hints are advisory.
boundary.zh-CN: 不加载内核；容量、超时、后端不可用显式返回。本地静态提示仅作辅助。

chain.en: Monaco cursor/source → completion permit/driver → clang suggestions → editor
chain.zh-CN: Monaco 光标/源码 → 补全许可/驱动 → clang 建议 → 编辑器

boundary.en: Separate bounded completion capacity; remote diagnostics selection does not relocate semantic completion.
boundary.zh-CN: 独立且有界的补全容量；选择远程诊断不会迁移语义补全。

chain.en: manual run → source validation → owner lease → compile → bpftool/Aya load → attach verification → result
chain.zh-CN: 手动运行 → 源码校验 → 所有者租约 → 编译 → bpftool/Aya 加载 → 挂载核验 → 结果

boundary.en: Linux shared kernel; compile success, load success and verified attachment are distinct. Some program types need a separate attach target.
boundary.zh-CN: Linux 共享内核；编译成功、加载成功和挂载已核验是不同状态。部分程序类型需要独立挂载目标。

chain.en: optional debug lines → instrumentation → verified attach → trace/ringbuf sampler → EventBus → breakpoint/event view
chain.zh-CN: 可选调试行 → 插桩 → 核验挂载 → trace/ringbuf 采样 → EventBus → 断点/事件视图

boundary.en: Trace probes do not pause the kernel. An eligible bpftool tracepoint run with an unsupported attach outcome may trigger a guarded Aya retry; sampling is bounded and asynchronous.
boundary.zh-CN: 追踪探针不暂停内核。符合条件的 bpftool tracepoint 运行在挂载不受支持时可触发受保护的 Aya 重试；采样有时限且异步。

chain.en: refresh owner inventory → inspect exact pin/details → confirm detach → driver cleanup/verification
chain.zh-CN: 刷新所有者挂载清单 → 检查精确 pin/详情 → 确认卸载 → 驱动清理/核验

boundary.en: Independent of active run capacity; wrong-owner or unavailable-driver requests cannot become a successful local cleanup.
boundary.zh-CN: 不依赖活跃运行容量；越权或驱动不可用不能伪装成本地清理成功。

chain.en: status/overview → global and per-user lease accounting → owner-checked driver dispatch → RAII release
chain.zh-CN: 状态/总览 → 全局及用户租约计数 → 所有者核验后驱动分发 → RAII 释放

boundary.en: local_process is current execution mode. Quotas are resource controls, not isolation; lease release does not mean kernel detach.
boundary.zh-CN: 当前执行模式为 local_process。配额是资源控制而非隔离；租约释放不等于内核卸载。

chain.en: bootstrap bearer → register/rotate credential → HMAC heartbeat → healthy/stale registry → inventory
chain.zh-CN: 引导 Bearer → 注册/轮换凭据 → HMAC 心跳 → 健康/过期注册表 → 清单

boundary.en: Off unless configured; timestamp, nonce, identity and body binding reject replay. Agent identity is not a browser teacher session.
boundary.zh-CN: 未配置时关闭；时间戳、nonce、身份和正文绑定拒绝重放。Agent 身份不是浏览器教师会话。

chain.en: teacher probe/compile submission → queue → signed claim + lease → isolated executor → sync/result or cancel/expire
chain.zh-CN: 教师探测/编译提交 → 队列 → 签名领取与租约 → 隔离执行器 → 同步/结果或取消/过期

boundary.en: In-memory jobs; lease identity rejects stale results; compile jobs return reports, never kernel-load or executable objects.
boundary.zh-CN: 作业在内存中；租约身份拒绝过期结果；编译作业只返回报告，不加载内核或返回可执行目标文件。

chain.en: eligible backend selection → owner-bound job submission → Agent compile report → poll/diagnostics/cancel
chain.zh-CN: 选择合格后端 → 按所有者绑定的作业提交 → Agent 编译报告 → 轮询/诊断/取消

boundary.en: Healthy non-shared_kernel clang_check Agents only. No remote run, remote completion, automatic header replication or silent local retry.
boundary.zh-CN: 仅接受健康、非 shared_kernel 且支持 clang_check 的 Agent。没有远程运行、远程补全、自动头文件复制或静默本地重试。

chain.en: learning center → five lab definitions/progress + localized Markdown → explicit editor handoff
chain.zh-CN: 学习中心 → 五个实验定义/进度 + 本地化 Markdown → 显式跳转编辑器

boundary.en: Course files are static public assets; navigation alone neither loads a template nor runs a lab.
boundary.zh-CN: 课程文件是公开静态资源；导航本身不载入模板，也不运行实验。

chain.en: returned run result + lab/source/attach evidence → structural assessment → LearningStore → learning event
chain.zh-CN: 返回的运行结果 + 实验/源码/挂载证据 → 结构化评估 → LearningStore → 学习事件

boundary.en: Only runs reaching record_learning_run with a lab ID are recorded. Validation/quota/driver early exits skip it; persistence error logs a warning without reverting execution.
boundary.zh-CN: 仅带实验 ID 且到达 record_learning_run 的运行被记录。校验/配额/驱动提前返回跳过记录；持久化失败只记警告，不撤销执行。

chain.en: history → owner-bound attempt lookup → source/feedback preview → confirmed draft restore → optional new manual run
chain.zh-CN: 历史 → 所有者绑定的提交查询 → 源码/反馈预览 → 确认恢复草稿 → 可选的新手动运行

boundary.en: Other-owner/missing records share 404; history restore never runs or detaches; SQL read failure is not replaced with stale local success.
boundary.zh-CN: 外部所有者/不存在的记录统一 404；恢复历史不运行也不卸载；SQL 读取失败不以陈旧本地成功代替。

chain.en: learning snapshots → student-filtered overview → selected student recent attempts → review
chain.zh-CN: 学习快照 → 学生过滤总览 → 所选学生近期提交 → 审阅

boundary.en: Separate teacher API; ordinary student endpoints remain owner-bound even for teachers. Overview is not a full account directory.
boundary.zh-CN: 独立教师 API；普通学生接口即使教师调用也绑定自身。总览不是完整账户目录。

name.zh-CN: 带版本校验的教师反馈

chain.en: review draft + expected revision → feedback CAS → persistent revision → student reads current feedback
chain.zh-CN: 审阅草稿 + 期望版本 → 反馈 CAS → 持久化版本 → 学生读取当前反馈

boundary.en: 409 on conflicting revision; no silent overwrite. Student visibility uses subsequent reads, not a dedicated feedback push channel.
boundary.zh-CN: 版本冲突返回 409，不静默覆盖。学生通过后续读取看到反馈，没有专用反馈推送通道。

chain.en: owner/category/severity/time filters → bounded event query → view or JSON/CSV export
chain.zh-CN: 所有者/分类/级别/时间筛选 → 有界事件查询 → 展示或 JSON/CSV 导出

boundary.en: SQL and bounded memory are distinct storage paths; exported history is not a complete durable execution audit.
boundary.zh-CN: SQL 与有界内存是不同存储路径；导出历史不是完整、持久的执行审计。

chain.en: EventBus fanout → session/Origin-checked WebSocket → overlap-safe snapshot recovery/backoff
chain.zh-CN: EventBus 扇出 → 会话/Origin 校验的 WebSocket → 防重叠快照恢复/退避

boundary.en: Lag closes with 1013 and slow sends are bounded; recovery is best-effort within retained history, not durable replay or exactly-once delivery.
boundary.zh-CN: 落后时以 1013 关闭且慢发送有时限；恢复仅在保留历史内尽力进行，不是持久重放或恰好一次传送。

chain.en: publish/read flags → unread count → sidebar badge → mark read
chain.zh-CN: 发布/已读标记 → 未读数量 → 侧栏标记 → 标为已读

boundary.en: Owner-scoped; marking read does not delete retained events.
boundary.zh-CN: 按所有者隔离；标为已读不删除保留事件。

chain.en: review exact filter scope → destructive confirmation → strict filter parse → delete matches → refresh
chain.zh-CN: 审阅精确筛选范围 → 危险确认 → 严格解析 → 删除匹配项 → 刷新

boundary.en: Invalid filters reject 400 instead of widening to delete-all; nonmatches and their read flags remain.
boundary.zh-CN: 非法筛选返回 400，不扩大成全删；未匹配项及其已读状态保留。

chain.en: read/update owner max records + drop_oldest/drop_new → retention policy → later history/publish behavior
chain.zh-CN: 读写自身最大记录数 + drop_oldest/drop_new → 保留策略 → 后续历史/发布行为

boundary.en: UI settings page is teacher-only, while this API is authenticated per-user; memory retention is bounded, not archival storage.
boundary.zh-CN: 设置页仅教师可见，但此 API 对已登录用户按自身开放；内存保留有界，不是归档存储。

chain.en: session-aware shell → role-visible navigation → target-bound confirmation → request → local draft/filter/locale state
chain.zh-CN: 感知会话的界面外壳 → 按角色导航 → 绑定目标的确认 → 请求 → 本地草稿/筛选/语言状态

boundary.en: Client controls supplement server guards; navigation can clear unconfirmed actions but cannot undo already dispatched work. Dashboard currently shows guidance, not live health polling.
boundary.zh-CN: 客户端控制补充而不替代服务端鉴权；导航可清未确认操作，不能撤回已发出的工作。Dashboard 当前是引导页，不主动轮询健康。

name.zh-CN: API 契约与 SDK 消费者

chain.en: Axum routes/access → OpenAPI → generated types/63 operations → SDK cookie/Origin/errors → Engine
chain.zh-CN: Axum 路由/权限 → OpenAPI → 生成类型/63 个操作 → SDK Cookie/Origin/错误 → Engine

boundary.en: 68 API operations include five Agent endpoints outside the SDK; frontend fetch hooks are separate consumers, not necessarily SDK calls.
boundary.zh-CN: 68 个 API 含 SDK 之外的 5 个 Agent 接口；前端 fetch hooks 是独立消费者，不应画成必经 SDK。

name.zh-CN: 经确认的 SSH 部署

chain.en: SSH plan → review exact target/host key → apply → verify preinstalled package → allowed remote action
chain.zh-CN: SSH plan → 审阅精确目标/主机密钥 → apply → 校验预装包 → 允许的远端动作

boundary.en: Current SSH flow manages an already installed Linux offline package; no package upload, bare-host bootstrap or automatic TLS provisioning.
boundary.zh-CN: 当前 SSH 流程管理已经安装的 Linux 离线包；没有包上传、裸机初始化或自动 TLS 配置。

chain.en: quality/contracts → offline package → metadata/checksum validation → safe extraction/install smoke → candidate-bound kernel evidence
chain.zh-CN: 质量/契约 → 离线包 → 元数据/校验和验证 → 安全解包/安装冒烟 → 候选包绑定内核证据

boundary.en: Checksums bind bytes, not publisher identity. CI definitions or past reports do not prove a current deployment or new kernel acceptance run.
boundary.zh-CN: 校验和绑定字节，不证明发行者身份。CI 定义或历史报告不能证明当前部署或新的内核验收。

label.zh-CN: 已校验且预装的发行包
经审阅的 up/down/status 动作

label.zh-CN: 种子本地教师并初始化认证

label.zh-CN: 就绪报告供后续手动运行参考

label.zh-CN: 已确认教师身份及兼容协议

label.zh-CN: 保存入学 TOTP 后正常登录

label.zh-CN: 保存注册 TOTP 后正常登录
初始化 TOTP 后正常登录

label.zh-CN: 服务端会话与角色进入 UI 外壳

光标触发的语义补全

label.en: diagnostics on an explicitly selected Agent
label.zh-CN: 在显式选定 Agent 上诊断

label.en: explicit Run action; check does not trigger run
label.zh-CN: 显式 Run；检查不触发运行
已选头文件进入本地诊断
已选头文件进入本地补全
已选头文件进入本地编译/加载

常驻补全缓存策略

补全耗时/缓存/拒绝计数

label.en: separate check permits and driver deadline
label.zh-CN: 独立检查许可与驱动时限

label.en: separate completion permits and driver deadline
label.zh-CN: 独立补全许可与驱动时限
所有者绑定的执行租约

label.en: same selected driver without an execution lease
label.zh-CN: 同一已选驱动，无需执行租约
挂载核验成功且启用调试/采样

label.en: attachments become inspectable; cleanup is explicit
label.zh-CN: 挂载可供查看；清理须显式执行

label.en: lab ID and run reaches recording stage
label.zh-CN: 具有实验 ID 且运行到达记录阶段
平台生命周期事件
保留历史中的内核/调试采样
按所有者隔离的实时采样

label.en: learning attempted/completed event after store success
label.zh-CN: 存储成功后的学习尝试/完成事件
提交参与实验进度聚合
持久化提交供历史读取

label.en: student attempts contribute to teacher overview
label.zh-CN: 学生提交参与教师总览

label.en: selected student attempt and expected revision
label.zh-CN: 选定学生提交及期望版本

label.en: current feedback on subsequent history reads
label.zh-CN: 后续历史读取包含当前反馈
Agent 身份、能力与新鲜度
合格健康的远程编译器列表

label.en: owner-scoped compile job, no remote run
label.zh-CN: 所有者绑定的编译作业，不是远程运行
终态编译报告或失败/取消
重连/落后时获取快照

label.en: event page marks visible stream/history read
label.zh-CN: 事件页将所见流/历史标为已读
实时到达更新已读/徽标流程

label.en: remove matching history and refresh view
label.zh-CN: 删除匹配历史并刷新视图

label.en: reconcile unread state without altering nonmatches

backend.zh-CN: PostgreSQL users/sessions；显式内存配置/降级路径

boundary.en: Raw session token stays in HttpOnly cookie, SQL stores its digest. Active-SQL login needs confirmed insertion; configured durable account mutations reject unconfirmed writes. Existing fallback is not cross-process revocation coordination.
boundary.zh-CN: 原始会话令牌只放 HttpOnly Cookie，SQL 存摘要。活跃 SQL 登录需要确认插入；配置了持久化的账户变更拒绝未确认写入。现有降级不提供跨进程撤销协调。

backend.en: PostgreSQL user_scripts or instance-local private JSON
backend.zh-CN: PostgreSQL user_scripts 或实例本地私有 JSON

boundary.en: Owner-bound operations; local admission → load → private temp/write/rename → publish cache. No cross-process file locking or crash-durability guarantee from rename alone.
boundary.zh-CN: 按所有者操作；本地准入 → 加载 → 私有临时文件/写入/rename → 发布缓存。没有跨进程文件锁，单靠 rename 不保证掉电持久性。

backend.en: PostgreSQL learning_attempts or local shared JSON snapshots
backend.zh-CN: PostgreSQL learning_attempts 或本地共享 JSON 快照

boundary.en: Serialized local writes and feedback revisions coordinate one process. Attempt persistence, kernel effects and event publication are not one transaction.
boundary.zh-CN: 本地写入串行化与反馈版本协调单进程。提交持久化、内核副作用、事件发布不是一个事务。

backend.en: Bounded per-owner memory, subscriptions, PostgreSQL event_records/event_user_settings through persistence worker
backend.zh-CN: 按所有者有界内存、订阅，以及经持久化 worker 写入的 PostgreSQL event_records/event_user_settings

boundary.en: Live publication is not an SQL-commit acknowledgement. Overflow, lag, deletion and retention bound history; current inventory does not prove queue/restart/failover consistency.
boundary.zh-CN: 实时发布不是 SQL 提交回执。溢出、落后、删除与保留策略限制历史；本清单不证明队列/重启/故障切换一致性。

backend.en: Trusted downloads/selection metadata; transient owner/instance workspaces
backend.zh-CN: 可信下载/选择元数据；临时所有者/实例工作目录

boundary.en: Verified headers are instance-shared. Local workspaces/cache and an Agent's isolated compile filesystem are different environments.
boundary.zh-CN: 已验证头文件为实例共享。本地工作区/缓存与 Agent 隔离编译文件系统是不同环境。

backend.en: In-process invitations, module status, Runner leases, Agent credentials/nonces/jobs, compiler mode/cache and metrics
backend.zh-CN: 进程内邀请、模块状态、Runner 租约、Agent 凭据/nonce/作业、编译模式/缓存与指标

boundary.en: Restart is not durable recovery of these control objects; no multi-Engine scheduler/registry coordination is implemented.
boundary.zh-CN: 重启不等于恢复这些控制对象；没有多 Engine 调度器/注册表协调。

backend.en: sessionStorage drafts/filters/reports; localStorage locale; HttpOnly session cookie managed separately
backend.zh-CN: sessionStorage 草稿/筛选/报告；localStorage 语言；单独管理的 HttpOnly 会话 Cookie

boundary.en: Browser cache is not a server-side submission or secret vault; a confirmed restore replaces the current draft but does not execute it.
boundary.zh-CN: 浏览器缓存不是服务端提交或秘密保险箱；确认恢复会替换当前草稿，但不执行它。

backend.en: Local Linux kernel, bpffs owner/instance pins, Aya-held links/maps
backend.zh-CN: 本地 Linux 内核、bpffs 所有者/实例 pin、Aya 持有的 link/map

boundary.en: Successful HTTP return, sampling timeout, lease release, logout and module stop are not equivalent to explicit detach. Namespaces/quotas do not create separate kernels.
boundary.zh-CN: HTTP 成功返回、采样到期、租约释放、退出和模块停止不等于显式 detach。命名空间/配额不能生成独立内核。
